channel.title: Sudan - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Sudan, every source cited.

item.title: Sudan offers Russia Red Sea investment, mining
item.description: Sudan's military leader proposed a free economic zone and opportunities in gold, copper, and other minerals to Russian investors.

item.title: UAE court jails eight for smuggling arms to Sudan
item.description: Eight individuals received life sentences for using companies and forged documents to move military equipment to Port Sudan.

item.title: RSF drones hit Sudan electricity network
item.description: Rapid Support Forces drone attacks have knocked out power stations from eastern Sudan to Khartoum.

item.title: Yale report finds El Fasher empty after RSF takeover
item.description: Satellite imagery shows vegetation growth in El Fasher, indicating a near-total absence of civilian life.
